title: ‘Dungeon Crawler Carl’s’ Breakout, Ryan Reynolds’ Jeanpool Stunt and More Comic-Con Highlights
content:
A new fandom took over San DiegoComic-Conthis year: “Dungeon Crawler Carl.”

While there were plenty of Marvel and DC superheroes walking around the convention center and the surrounding Gaslamp Quarter (not to mention the Trekkies and “Star Wars” storm troopers, and the other comic book cosplayers), there were just as many people sporting t-shirts featuring Princess Donut, the tiara-wearing talking cat from the popular book series.

In that sense, this year’s SDCC felt somewhat like a changing of the geek guard. Sure, hundreds of diehard Marvel fans began queuing for Saturday evening’s Hall H presentation on Thursday, but there was just as much buzz around newer (“Percy Jackson,” “The Vampire Lestat”)  and niche IP (“Neuromancer”), plus plenty of nostalgia fare (“Spaceballs,” “Grimm,” “Pan’s Labyrinth”).

Here are some of the highlights:

Author Matt Dinniman’s book series, which turns Earth into a video game-inspired alien game show, has skyrocketed in popularity — with more than 10 million copies sold — and just last month,Peacock ordered a live-action seriesproduced by Seth MacFarlane. At Comic-Con, Dinniman hosted two panels alongside Jeff Hays, who voices more than 200 zany characters in the audiobook versions of the novels. To the delight of fans, Dinniman revealed that Hays will voice Princess Donut in the Peacock show. No other casting has been announced, but fans are patiently waiting to see how the beloved book series will come to life. Meanwhile, Dinniman is hard at work on the final two novels in the planned 10-book series.

“There’s so much I want to tackle. All this stuff seems to be happening at once because we started doing it all at once,” he said, dropping by theVarietyStudio, presented by Google TV. “I would love for there to be a full-on video game. … I would love to have an MMORPG, like a ‘Fallout’-style game, in the ‘Dungeon Crawler Carl’ universe. That’d be badass.”

After skipping Comic-Con last year, Marvel fans were ready to see what’s in store for “Avengers: Doomsday,” which brings back Robert Downey Jr. as the new big bad, Doctor Doom. Marvel chief Kevin Feige packed Hall H with the movie’s A-listers — Pedro Pascal, Paul Rudd, Anthony Mackie and returning stars Chris Evans and Hayley Atwell were among those who made the trek — to show off an exclusive trailer that teased more of Doom’s backstory. But the breaking news was that Ryan Gosling will star in a Ghost Rider movie and Ryan Coogler’s “Black Panther 3” will introduce “Alien: Romulus” actor David Jonsson as the new hero, Prince T’Challa II, son of the late Chadwick Boseman’s T’Challa.

DC Studios had a smaller presence at the con, focusing on previously announced projects instead of forecasting the future. The studio brought this summer’s “Lanterns” show, starring Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre, to Hall H. The HBO series, which puts a detective spin on the Green Lantern character, is expected to be a prestige hit for DC, and Pierre will reprise his Green Lantern role in next summer’s “Superman” sequel, “Man of Tomorrow.” In other movie news, “Clayface” star Tom Rhys Harries made a surprise appearance at the Jim Lee and Friends panel following the debut of a creepy new trailer for the horror thriller.

With summer movie season winding down, studios and streamers were eager to remind fans what’s coming to their televisions this fall. Apple TV came out swinging with a two-hour Hall H panel — the studio’s first major Comic-Con installation — that was largely dedicated to flexing its established hits like “Widows Bay” and “Silo,” plus a first look at the highly anticipated sci-fi drama “Neuromancer,” with Callum Turner, and “Matchbox the Movie,” starring John Cena and Jessica Biel. Prime Video focused on heavy-hitting IP vehicles in “The Lord of the Rings: Rings of Power,” “Blade Runner 2099” and “Carrie” from Mike Flanagan. “Rings of Power” has tons of momentum heading into Season 3 with the addition of geek-god Jamie Campbell Bower (who played Vecna on “Stranger Things” and showed off his DJ skills at IGN’s party), while “Blade Runner 2099” seems destined for hit status thanks to the star power of co-leads Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer, and a confident vision from showrunner Silka Luisa.

SDCC isn’t just for comic book lovers; there’s plenty to keep cinephiles entertained, too. Over the past few years, indie distributors Neon and A24 have used the convention as a launching pad for some of their buzziest titles — especially horror movies, like “Together” and “Talk to Me.” This year, SDCC scheduled back-to-back showcases for a couple bloody-good films: Na Hong-jin’s “Hope” from Neon and Adam Wingard’s “Onslaught” for A24. For his first trip to Comic-Con,director Na detailed the 10-year journeyto make his alien invasion action movie — and made the crowd cackle by revealing that “90%” of the characters don’t make it to the end credits.

The “Onslaught” crew — SDCC-vets Wingard, Adria Arjona, Dan Stevens and Rebecca Hall, with fan favorite Drew Starkey (welcomed by ear-piercing shrieks from the audience) — debuted a new trailer for the blood-soaked action movie. Arjona stars as a badass Army sniper grappling with PTSD, who must protect her young daughter from a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers.

“I just felt crazy protective over her,” Arjona said of her young co-star, Blake Kennedy. “It’s that beautiful mother feral need to make sure that your child is fine.”

Cosplay isn’t only for the fans; superstars went incognito to create some of the convention’s best surprises. (Think Andrew Garfield walking up to the mic in full Spider-Man costume 15 years ago.)

This year, Rick Moranis made his Comic-Con debut to promote the long-awaited “Spaceballs” sequel, “The New One,” which ends his 30-year acting hiatus. The Hall H crowd went berserk when Moranis revealed himself from under a gigantic Lord Dark Helmet helmet.

Johnny Depptransformed into the “Christmas Carol” curmudgeon Scrooge for his surprise appearance at an activation for “Ebenezer.” A crowd of hundreds braved the San Diego heat for a couple of hours in hopes of catching a glimpse of the actor. “Have you no jobs?” Depp (as Scrooge) croaked, ribbing the crowd before heading to Hall H to debut the movie’s trailer.

But the grand prize goes to Ryan Reynolds, who crashed Marvel Studios’ Hall H presentationdressed as “Jeanpool”— a Canadian tuxedoed Deadpool, which might also be a subtle nod to X-Men’s Jean Grey — to beg for a role in the new “Avengers: Doomsday.” After the convention, Reynolds revealed that he traipsed around the convention floor without handlers or security, shaking hands and taking selfies with fans — all without getting recognized.
title_zh: 《地下城爬行者卡爾(Dungeon Crawler Carl)》的突破、瑞安·雷諾斯(Ryan Reynolds)的Jeanpool特技以及更多聖地牙哥國際漫畫展的亮點
content_zh:
今年的聖地牙哥國際漫畫展(San Diego Comic-Con)出現了一個新的粉絲熱潮：“Dungeon Crawler Carl”。

雖然在會展中心及周邊的煤氣燈區(Gaslamp Quarter)裡，有許多漫威(Marvel)和DC超級英雄四處走動（更不用說星際迷和《星際大戰》(Star Wars)的風暴兵，以及其他漫畫書角色扮演者），但同樣也有許多人穿著印有來自受歡迎書籍系列的戴著王冠的會說話的貓公主甜甜圈公主(Princess Donut)的T恤。

從這個意義上來看，今年的SDCC感覺有點像是宅文化的交接儀式。當然，數百名死忠的漫威粉絲在星期四就開始排隊等待星期六晚上的H廳(Hall H)展示，但對於較新的作品（《波西·傑克森》(Percy Jackson)、《吸血鬼萊斯特》(The Vampire Lestat)）和小眾知識產權（如《神經漫遊者》(Neuromancer)）的討論同樣熱烈，還有許多懷舊作品（如《太空球》(Spaceballs)、《格林》(Grimm)、《潘的迷宮》(Pan’s Labyrinth)）。

以下是一些亮點：

作者馬特·迪尼曼(Matt Dinniman)的書籍系列，將地球變成一個受到視頻遊戲啟發的外星遊戲秀，人氣暴漲——銷量超過1000萬本——而就在上個月，Peacock訂購了一部由塞斯·麥克法蘭(Seth MacFarlane)製作的真人劇集。在漫畫展上，迪尼曼與為小說有聲書版本配音超過200個古怪角色的傑夫·海斯(Jeff Hays)共同主持了兩個小組討論會。令粉絲們高興的是，迪尼曼透露海斯將在Peacock的劇集中為甜甜圈公主配音。其他角色的選角尚未公布，但粉絲們耐心等待著這部受人喜愛的書籍系列如何呈現。與此同時，迪尼曼正在全力以赴完成計劃中的10本書系列中的最後兩本小說。

“我有很多想要處理的事情。所有這些事情似乎同時發生，因為我們開始同時進行，”他在由Google TV呈現的《綜藝》(Variety)工作室中表示。“我希望能有一款完整的視頻遊戲……我希望能在‘Dungeon Crawler Carl’宇宙中有一款MMORPG，就像‘輻射’(Fallout)風格的遊戲，那會很酷。”

在去年跳過漫畫展後，漫威粉絲們準備好看看《復仇者聯盟：末日》(Avengers: Doomsday)的未來，這部電影將羅伯特·唐尼·小(Robert Downey Jr.)再次帶回作為新反派，毀滅博士(Doctor Doom)。漫威首席執行官凱文·費吉(Kevin Feige)在H廳聚集了電影的明星陣容——佩德羅·帕斯卡(Pedro Pascal)、保羅·路德(Paul Rudd)、安東尼·麥基(Anthony Mackie)以及回歸的克里斯·埃文斯(Chris Evans)和海莉·阿特維爾(Hayley Atwell)等人，展示了一段獨家預告片，揭示了更多關於毀滅博士的背景故事。但最新消息是瑞安·高斯林(Ryan Gosling)將主演一部《幽靈騎士》(Ghost Rider)電影，而瑞安·庫格勒(Ryan Coogler)的《黑豹3》(Black Panther 3)將介紹《異形：羅馬利斯》(Alien: Romulus)演員大衛·約翰遜(David Jonsson)作為新英雄，查德維克·博斯曼(Chadwick Boseman)所飾演的查拉(T’Challa)的兒子，查拉二世(Prince T’Challa II)。

DC工作室在大會上的出席較少，專注於先前宣布的項目，而非預測未來。該工作室帶來了今夏的《燈籠(Lanterns)》秀，主演為凱爾·錢德勒(Kyle Chandler)和亞倫·皮爾(Aaron Pierre)，並在H廳進行展示。這部HBO系列劇為綠燈俠角色增添了偵探的元素，預計將成為DC的一部優質作品，而皮爾將在明夏的《超人(Superman)》續集《明日之人(Man of Tomorrow)》中重返其綠燈俠角色。在其他電影消息中，《泥土怪(Clayface)》的明星湯·瑞斯·哈里斯(Tom Rhys Harries)在吉姆·李(Jim Lee)和朋友們的座談會上驚喜現身，隨著一部令人毛骨悚然的新預告片的首映。

隨著夏季電影季的結束，工作室和串流平台急於提醒粉絲們這個秋季將在他們的電視上推出的內容。Apple TV以兩小時的H廳座談會強勢登場——這是該工作室首次在Comic-Con上進行的大型展示——主要用於展示其已建立的熱門作品，如《寡婦灣(Widows Bay)》和《筒倉(Silo)》，以及備受期待的科幻劇《神經漫遊者(Neuromancer)》的首映，主演為卡倫·特納(Callum Turner)，還有約翰·塞納(John Cena)和潔西卡·比爾(Jessica Biel)主演的《火柴盒電影(Matchbox the Movie)》。Prime Video則專注於重磅IP作品，包括《魔戒：力量之戒(The Lord of the Rings: Rings of Power)》、《銀翼殺手2099(Blade Runner 2099)》和麥克·弗拉納根(Mike Flanagan)的《凱莉(Carrie)》。隨著極客之神傑米·坎貝爾·鮑爾(Jamie Campbell Bower)的加入，《力量之戒》在進入第三季時擁有巨大的動力（他曾在《怪奇物語(Stranger Things)》中飾演維克納(Vecna)，並在IGN的派對上展示了他的DJ技能），而《銀翼殺手2099》則因主演米歇爾·譚(Michelle Yeoh)和亨特·謝弗(Hunter Schafer)的明星效應以及製作人西爾卡·路易莎(Silka Luisa)的自信視野而注定成為熱門。

SDCC不僅僅是漫畫書愛好者的盛會；對於電影愛好者來說也有很多娛樂內容。在過去幾年中，獨立發行商Neon和A24利用這個大會作為一些最受關注作品的發射台——尤其是恐怖電影，如《一起(Together)》和《跟我說(Talk to Me)》。今年，SDCC安排了連續的展示，介紹了幾部血腥好片：來自Neon的那·洪進(Na Hong-jin)的《希望(Hope)》和亞當·溫加德(Adam Wingard)的《突襲(Onslaught)》。在他首次參加Comic-Con時，導演那·洪進詳細介紹了他製作外星入侵動作電影的十年旅程——並透露“90%”的角色未能活到片尾字幕，讓觀眾捧腹大笑。

《突襲》劇組——SDCC老將溫加德、阿德里亞·阿爾霍納(Adria Arjona)、丹·史蒂文斯(Dan Stevens)和瑞貝卡·霍爾(Rebecca Hall)，以及受歡迎的德魯·斯塔基(Drew Starkey)（受到觀眾尖叫的熱烈歡迎）——為這部血腥動作電影首映了新預告片。阿爾霍納在片中飾演一名面對創傷後壓力症的強悍軍隊狙擊手，必須保護她年幼的女兒免受一支基因工程超級士兵的叛變小隊的威脅。

“我對她感到非常保護，”阿爾霍納談到她的年輕搭檔布雷克·肯尼迪(Blake Kennedy)時說。“這是一種美麗的母性本能，想確保你的孩子平安。”

Cosplay不僅僅是粉絲的專利；超級明星們也化身為普通人，帶來了一些大會上最驚喜的時刻。（想想15年前的安德魯·加菲爾德(Andrew Garfield)全副武裝地走上麥克風，扮演蜘蛛人。）

今年，瑞克·莫蘭尼斯(Rick Moranis)首次亮相Comic-Con，為期待已久的《太空大戰(Spaceballs)》續集《新的一部(The New One)》宣傳，結束了他長達30年的演藝 hiatus。當莫蘭尼斯從一個巨大的黑暗頭盔(Lord Dark Helmet)下現身時，Hall H的觀眾們瘋狂了。

約翰尼·德普(Johnny Depp)則化身為《聖誕頌歌(Christmas Carol)》中的老古板斯克魯奇(Scrooge)，在《以便尼澤(Ebenezer)》的活動中驚喜現身。數百名觀眾冒著聖地牙哥的酷熱，耐心等待幾個小時，只為一睹這位演員的風采。“你們就這麼閒嗎？”德普(斯克魯奇)嘲諷道，調侃觀眾，然後前往Hall H首映電影的預告片。

但最驚人的獎項則屬於瑞安·雷諾茲(Ryan Reynolds)，他化身為“Jeanpool”——一位穿著加拿大式牛仔服的死侍(Deadpool)，這也可能是對《X戰警(X-Men)》中的琴·葛蕾(Jean Grey)的微妙致敬——闖入漫威影業(Marvel Studios)的Hall H發表會，乞求在新片《復仇者聯盟：末日(Avengers: Doomsday)》中獲得一個角色。會後，雷諾茲透露他在會場上四處遊蕩，沒有隨行人員或保安，與粉絲握手並拍照——全程沒有被認出來。
